_comment: Tier-2 ANOVA from summary stats. Step 1: GROUP_CATEGORY(region) + AGG_AVERAGE/VARIANCE/COUNT produces one row per region. Step 2: TEST_ANOVA_F in post_tests reads (mean, n, variance) per row and reconstructs SSB/SSW from the per-group summaries. Useful when the same Process call serves both the headline group rows and the inferential test.
